relationships.subject: CTB-SAP
relationships.evidence_quote: CTB-SAP injection into the L4-SpN significantly increased IBA1 immunofluorescence and microglial cell number in the L4-SDH

relationships.subject: IB4-SAP
relationships.evidence_quote: intra-L4-SpN injection of IB4-SAP significantly decreased the number of IB4+ DRG neurons (Figure 4E,F) but did not cause microgliosis

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: spinal TRPV1+ nerve fiber ablation alone did not increase IBA1 immunofluorescence or microglial cell number

relationships.subject: peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: L4-SpN transection markedly increased the immunofluorescence levels of IBA1 and the number of microglia (referred to as microgliosis) 7 days post-injury

key_findings: Early nerve-injury microgliosis in the dorsal horn maps to projection territories of injured myelinated Aβ-fibers
Ablating TRPV1+ or IB4+ C-fibers does not cause or alter microgliosis, whereas Aβ-fiber damage is sufficient
